title: MCP stage_update: cacheAsBitmap not in DisplayObjectUpdates type or tool schema
description: DisplayObjectUpdates type (packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts:7) does not include cacheAsBitmap. The stage_update MCP tool schema (packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts:597) also lacks a cacheAsBitmap shorthand param. Agents can pass cacheAsBitmap via the freeform updates:{} bag and the runtime spread will apply it since TypeScript checks are elided at runtime, but: (1) the type system does not enforce or document it; (2) the MCP tool description does not mention it so agents will not know to set it. Given that the SWF encoder already supports cacheAsBitmap (packages/swf/src/sprite.ts:321, packages/swf/src/filters.ts:540), agents should be able to toggle it via stage_update. Fix: add cacheAsBitmap?: boolean to DisplayObjectUpdates and to the stage_update registry shorthand params (alongside blendMode/colorEffect). Evidence: timeline.ts:7 type definition, registry.ts:988 handler, vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts:597 MCP schema.
